guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: jangly bright indie crunch with slight chorus
tone.profile: jangly bright indie crunch with slight chorus
tone.summary: A bright, compressed signal chain using a low-gain British amp model (AC30 style) paired with a clear 4x12 cabinet, enhanced by chorus for the signature jangly sound.

rig.name: Arctic Monkeys - Fluorescent Adolescent - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal and add initial brightness/attack.
blocks.gap: A dedicated clean boost or pre-amp is ideal, but Boost serves to gently push the signal without adding grit.

blocks.purpose: Provide light edge-of-breakup and natural grit without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its clean, British character, mimicking the desired Plexi bias/light breakup feel.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic bright British tone and headroom.
Provide the classic British voicing and bright upper mids.
Enhance the jangly upper mids and brightness.
Add the required subtle, signature chorus effect.
Add subtle space and depth without sounding deep or wet.
blocks.gap: The requirement was 'small room,' so a low mix Room reverb is used to add atmosphere subtly.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more open, jangly British voicing.

proposals.recommendedAsset: open-sounding 1x or 2x cab IR (e.g., Vox/AC30 style)
proposals.reason: The current 4x12 might be too full; a smaller, more open cabinet will enhance the jangly upper mids.
